text:
Marta Chen: Heads-up — postmortem notes from the 01:20 UTC latency spike. We need SLO/SLA follow-ups and to assign owners for remediation and recurring pattern analysis. Error budget burned ~3% on the spike. Can we decide on targets and actions?

Liam O'Connor: I can own the SLO recalibration doc. Propose we tighten 95th p50 target for inference-api from 250ms to 220ms for prod tier A; keep tier B unchanged for now.

Noah Patel: Agree on owner. Will take lead on dashboard updates and alert tuning. I'll add a new panel for error_budget_remaining and a burn rate graph.

Jessica Ruiz: I'll update runbook and include a 'rapid rollback' step + suggested thresholds. Also add the 'fallback to smaller model' step.

SRE Bot: Incident 2026-03-23T01:20Z logged → ticket INF-2376 created. Auto-runbook snapshot attached.

Alex Kim: Quick question — do we want to change the breach window from 5m to 1m for auto-escalation? That was noisy previously.

Liam O'Connor: Let's keep auto-escalation at 5m for now but add a canary rule at 1m that only affects dedicated pool. That will avoid noisy alerts on momentary spikes.

Marta Chen: Timeline proposals: dashboards ready by EOD Fri, runbook edits + PR by Tue, SLO doc updated + stakeholder review by next Thu. Can we get volunteers for each action?

Noah Patel: Dashboards: I'll PR by Thu EOD. Assigning ticket INF-2380.

Jessica Ruiz: Runbook PR by Mon. Will include the rollback snippet and playbook link.

Liam O'Connor: SLO doc PR by Wed, then review with product and infra on Thu.

Marta Chen: Owners summary: SLO doc — Liam; Dashboards/alerts — Noah; Runbook — Jessica; Ops play for recurring analysis — Alex; I'll coordinate postmortem verification and close loop with customer success on SLA communication.

Alex Kim: I'll take recurring pattern analysis. Plan: run 7-day rolling anomaly detection on latency and kv-cache hit rate, add monthly review.

Noah Patel: Grafana query for the new panel (draft):
```
sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference-api",le="+Inf"}[5m])) by (service)
/
sum(rate(requests_total{job="inference-api"}[5m])) by (service)
```
Will adjust for histogram_exemplars.

Marta Chen: Cool. Can someone add a short blurb for the SLO change rationale for the changelog? Need it for legal/CS.

Liam O'Connor: I'll draft rationale: "tightening 95th to 220ms reduces tail risk after observed regressed kernels; no expected cost impact due to caching and batching." Will post tonight.

Noah Patel: I'll schedule a 30-min sync Fri to walk dashboards and alert behavior. Calendar invite incoming.

Jessica Ruiz: :thumbsup: Thanks all — will start runbook edits now.

Marta Chen: Thanks — marking action items in INF-2376, INF-2380. We'll reconvene after the Fri sync. :white_check_mark:
